text: Ich bin seit der Erfahrung entspannter und zuversichtlicher. Ich habe weniger Versagensängste und kann meine Arbeit mit mehr Freude machen. Insgesamt fühle ich mich psychisch stabiler.
No difference either

I feel more at peace with life and death, and that has helped my mental health a lot. I used to have a lot of anxiety about death, my own and my loved ones'. Now I feel more accepting and more grateful for the time we have. I'm happier and more present with my family. I've also become more open to spirituality, which I never thought I would be.
less depressed. more hopeful. like theres a light now

Ich verstehe mich selbst besser, besonders meine Wut und meine Ängste. Das hat mir geholfen, mich selbst mehr anzunehmen. Ich bin weniger angespannt und fühle mich wohler in meiner Haut. Meine Beziehung ist liebevoller geworden, und ich habe das Gefühl, dass mein Partner und ich uns näher sind als je zuvor.

I was close to a breakdown before the experience. I was exhausted, crying in the car, snapping at everyone. The experience gave me a sense of strength and also a lot of love, for my mother, for my kids, for myself. I realised I'd forgotten to love myself in all of this. Since then I take a little time for myself every day, even if it's just ten minutes with a cup of tea in the garden. My mental health is much better, I'm less depressed and anxious, and I can enjoy moments with my family even when things are hard. I also appreciate my mother in a new way. Even though she doesn't know who I am most days, there are still moments of connection, a smile, a hand squeeze, and I cherish those now instead of only grieving what's lost.
Mir geht es insgesamt etwas besser
I'm less anxious about what people think of me, and that has improved my mood and my social life. I also understand myself better, I can see where my need for approval comes from.
It deepened my spirituality and made me feel more connected to something bigger, but I wouldn't say my mental health changed. I was fine before and I'm fine now.
Ich bin weniger erschöpft und fühle mich psychisch stabiler, seit ich mich besser abgrenzen kann. Ich habe auch mehr Freude an meinem Beruf, weil ich nicht mehr so ausgebrannt bin.

My depression has lifted a lot. I used to feel hopeless and unlucky, and I think that belief was a big part of my depression. Seeing it as just a story has given me a lot of freedom. I'm more grateful for what I have and I notice good things more. I'm also more open to opportunities, because I don't assume they'll go wrong anymore.
Better mood, less anxiety

Ich bin weniger selbstkritisch und dadurch insgesamt glücklicher. Ich mag mich mehr, so wie ich bin, und habe das Gefühl, dass ich mir selbst ein besserer Freund geworden bin. Das hat meine Stimmung und mein Selbstwertgefühl deutlich verbessert.

I'm much less anxious than I used to be. I had generalized anxiety for years, and I was always worried about something, my health, my partner, my job. Learning to tolerate uncertainty has been the key for me. I'm more relaxed, I sleep better and I'm happier. I'm also more open to new experiences, because I'm not so afraid of the unknown. I've started traveling more, which I used to avoid because it felt too unpredictable.
I feel lighter, happier, and more positive about life in general.
Ich habe mich nach der Erfahrung einige Wochen lang sehr gut gefühlt, voller Energie und Lebensfreude. Das hat dann aber nachgelassen, und heute geht es mir ungefähr so wie vorher.

I'm more self-aware and that has helped me manage my depression better. I catch the downward spiral earlier, and I know what helps me: sleep, talking to my friends, getting outside. I still have depressive episodes but they're shorter and less intense.
I feel more love and less resentment towards people. Happier overall.

Ich bin psychisch gesünder geworden, weil ich gelernt habe, meine Gedanken nicht so ernst zu nehmen. Ich habe früher sehr viel gegrübelt und mir Sorgen gemacht, und das hat mich oft in depressive Phasen gebracht. Heute erkenne ich, wenn ich wieder anfange zu grübeln, und kann mich davon lösen. Ich verstehe auch besser, woher meine negativen Gedanken kommen.
I'm generally more stable and less anxious

At first it was really bad for my mental health. I had anxiety, panic attacks and I avoided crowds for over a year. I was afraid I'd broken something in my brain. With therapy, I slowly got better, and now I think I'm actually more resilient and self-aware than before. But I wouldn't recommend going through it the way I did.
Ich achte mehr auf mich und meine Bedürfnisse und fühle mich dadurch ausgeglichener. Ich bin dankbarer für die ruhigen Momente im Alltag.
Less anxious about my illness and more able to enjoy life despite it. I appreciate the good days so much more now.

My anxiety is still there, but my relationship with it has changed. I'm kinder to myself, and that has improved my mental health. I'm less ashamed of being anxious, and I talk about it more openly with friends.

Ich bin heute psychisch stabiler, obwohl ich mehr fühle als früher. Das klingt vielleicht widersprüchlich, aber ich glaube, das Verdrängen hat mich auf Dauer viel mehr Kraft gekostet. Ich hatte früher oft unerklärliche Erschöpfungszustände und Schlafprobleme, und die sind seit der Erfahrung deutlich besser geworden. Ich verstehe mich selbst besser und weiß jetzt, welche alten Wunden ich mit mir herumtrage. Ich habe auch angefangen, mit einem Therapeuten darüber zu sprechen, was mir sehr hilft. Und ich bin dankbarer für mein Leben, weil ich gesehen habe, wie viel ich schon durchgestanden habe.
I'm more patient and less anxious as a parent. I love my daughter so much and I'm better at showing it.
I'm less burnt out and more balanced, and I'm finally enjoying my free time instead of feeling guilty about it.
Ich bin fröhlicher und lockerer geworden.

I'm in therapy now and that has helped a lot. I'm less depressed and I understand myself better. The experience was what got me there. I'm also more open in general, to new ideas, to people, and to my own feelings.

I feel much more love and gratitude in my life. Going through IVF was hard, but the experience gave me a foundation of trust and love that carried me. I'm grateful for my partner, for our families, for the doctors, for every little sign of hope. I'm also more open to the idea that life doesn't always go according to plan, and that this can be okay. My mental health is better than it has been in years, even with everything we went through. I'm so excited to be a mum.
Mehr Lebensfreude
I'm less exhausted and resentful, and I like myself more. I understand now that my people pleasing came from wanting to be loved, and that I can love myself without needing everyone's approval.
More stable mood, and I'm better at preventing burnout
Ich bin selbstbewusster und zuversichtlicher geworden. Ich habe weniger Angst vor der Zukunft und genieße mein Leben mehr.
Better, less anxious, more relaxed. Not 100% but way better

My performance anxiety used to spill into everything, and I was often depressed because I felt I wasn't living up to my potential. Since the experience I feel freer and more joyful, especially when I play music. I'm more open to experimenting, I've started writing my own songs, which I never dared before. I also feel more love for my audience and for the other musicians I play with. It's like I've reconnected with why I started making music in the first place.
Kaum Auswirkungen
I feel calmer and more present. I'm less anxious and I enjoy simple things more.

I'm more emotionally stable and better at managing my mood swings. I understand my emotions better, I can name them and see where they come from. My relationship has improved a lot because of this, and I feel more secure and loved. I'm also more curious about myself, I've been reading about psychology and attachment styles, which helps me make sense of things.
Leider eher schlechter. Ich habe seit der Erfahrung immer wieder Phasen, in denen ich mich unwirklich fühle und Angst habe, verrückt zu werden. Ich bin deswegen jetzt in Behandlung.
